components.title: Separate product and custody revisions
components.summary: Distinguishes the 44cd product gate from the later 1a05 custody recipe used by the root build route.

facts.statement: The root build is reported to invoke the separate custody revision 1a051787c2e15ab88fb924cb931054f16d5f1bd1, reconstruct exact Recoil bbeb1eb, and compile the isolated HighBar product 44cd. This is the intended two revision product/custody protocol; it does not make the older recipe embedded in 44cd a bbeb reconstruction recipe.
Using the successor custody route establishes source reconstruction intent only. It does not establish a completed build, CTest, two peer, callback, refund, game, or native runtime acceptance.
